name: Sutra Apps registry
notes: The default Apps registry for Sutra Desktop (ADR-039; Publish program Q-1). Served by GitHub Pages from the sutra repo's website/apps/. Entries are signed by a publisher listed under publishers (ADR-041, ed25519 over {publisher_id, app_id, version, manifest_schema, artifact_sha256, sutra_version_range}); artifacts sit under artifacts/<id>-<version>.tgz beside this file. Maintained with sutra-ui/modules_registry.py (check | add).
